 return {str(path):hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(directory.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()}

 def __init__(self):self.items=[];self.records=[]

   self.records.append((report.nodeid,report.when,report.outcome,report.duration))
